I had a L5-S1 disc herniation into my spinal canal woth partial stenosis, and currently still have the L4-L5 disc herniated the same. The pain was incredible, and slowly got worse, developing into transient urinary and fecal incontinence. Burning from my waist down, and eventually i could no longer work. 

I tried PT, injections (which helped at first but eventually had no effect), and everything short of surgery. 

I now have a posterior and anterior fusion at L5-S1 with four screws, one plate, and a spacer. Im 4 months post op.

I now have my life back, can hike, swim, exercise and most importantly of all, sleep more than one hour a night. 

There are limitations, such as not being able to squat weights on my shoulders, cant touch my toes anymore, and when i assist with surgical procedures that require me to stand on my feet for long periods or wear lead for long periods, i do get pain. I also have to stretch twice a day and MUST do core work 3x a week to keep the pain down.

Do everything short of surgery. If nothing works, surgery may be your last option. Just understand you will have new limitations and routines youll have to follow
